body.description: Rosa, Juno's mother, a woman in her thirties: dark hair in a long braid, red-orange blouse, dark trousers, sharp warm face. a person of a small South Texas border town generations after the sky turned white, sun-faded patched clothes, dust on the boots
body.style_description: modern indie action-adventure pixel art: chunky stylized proportions, big bold readable silhouette, saturated colours, lineless with strong graphic light and shadow shapes, expressive and punchy
